, live theming), chart area kind, native date/number inputs, table auto-pagination
Generative UI for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
Interactive, rich components rendered inline alongside the model's textual responses.
English · 简体中文

🌐 Live Product Site ·
🎬 Real Demo ·
🚀 Quick Start ·

📖 Component Syntax (SKILL.md)
`dsh-genui` turns DeepSeek Harness (DSH) assistant replies into **safe, fully interactive UI surface
-genui` turns DeepSeek Harness (DSH) assistant replies into **safe, fully interactive UI surfaces**.
Ask “How are this month’s orders doing?”, and instead of plain text or raw code blocks, the response
streams out an **interactive sortable data table**, **audio/video players**, **draggable function p
lots**, **self-grading quizzes**, or a **persistent workspace dock** — all embedded seamlessly withi
ing quizzes**, or a **persistent workspace dock** — all embedded seamlessly within the conversation.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This repository is a fork** of `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui` 0.14.0 (package name ke
pt for drop-in compatibility), versioned `0.14.0-fork.3`. Delta over upstream: the diagram engine is
**pele** instead of mermaid (1.02 MB, −70% asset weight, live CSS-variable theming, `mindmap`/`time
line` whitelisted), plus capability additions — `chart` `kind:"area"`, native `date` / `datetime-loc
al` / `time` / `number` inputs with `min`/`max`/`step`, automatic table pagination (`pageSize`, row
cap raised to 200), and upstream's **Computed fields** (input-driven local recalculation, ported fro
m the 0.15.0 fix line). See FORK.md and the CHANGELOG for the full record. **This fork is not publis
hed to npm** — the Quick Start below separates the upstream npm install from building this fork from
pm** — the Quick Start below separates the upstream npm install from building this fork from source.
## 🎬 Real Interface Showcase

> [!NOTE]
> **Real Interface Captures:** All recordings and screenshots below are captured directly
from real DSH interface rendering — no conceptual mockups or faked pre-renders. Demo media is inheri
ted from the upstream repository: this fork carries the entire component surface shown here, with on
ly the diagram engine swapped (pele instead of mermaid).
### 40-Second Walkthrough
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f5db33ec-7471-4d4a-a85b-79c9962ab4ef
(Click the thumbnail to download the original MP4 if the GitHub video player fails to load. The prom
pt sequence is documented in demo-prompts.md.)
### Three Concrete Real Outputs
| 1. Monitoring Panel: Answer is the Dashboard | 2. Function Plot: Drag to Redraw Instantly | 3. Com

posable Hierarchy: Work Surface |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Data Insights:** Eyebrow stats, filterable/drill-down service table, grouped totals, and spark/r
ing cells directly live in the assistant reply. | **Zero-Latency Exploration:** `plot` draws mathema
tical curves; drag parameter sliders to re-calculate and redraw locally in real time. | **Structured
Hierarchy:** Display quotes, stat cards, ring progress, and labeled chapter dividers composed decla
ratively by the model. |
## ✨ Before vs. After

| Scenario | Plain Text Response | With dsh-genui |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Business Overview** |
“Revenue this month is ¥128,430 (+12.4% MoM); conversion rate is slightly dipping…” | One line of c
oncise prose + 3 stat cards (revenue/orders/conversion), a trend chart, and a progress bar rendered

right beside it. |
| **Data Exploration** | Type another prompt to ask the model to re-sort or filte
r. | Click table headers to **sort numbers locally**, or use the search box to filter rows in real t

ime. |
| **Parameter Tuning** | Re-prompt the model and wait for another full generation. | Drag sli

ders to see curves update in **sub-millisecond speed** with animation preview. |
| **Next Actions**
| Copy text and manually perform follow-up tasks elsewhere. | Click interactive action buttons (e.g.
“Refresh”, “Switch View”) to trigger **bidirectional model event loops**. |
